request.subject: UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, sinister, grim and evil, not cute. Their colours: ceremonial cloth of black and charcoal with deep blood-red linings, sashes and trim, embroidered with tarnished gold occult sigils; dull brass; pale cream candle wax and parchment; bright red fresh blood on blades; and one small accent, a glowing spring green, only as candle flames and sparks.
layers.negative: cute, friendly smile, tentacles, tentacle hands, skull face, skull mask, skeleton, glowing eyes, empty black face, monster face, teal, cyan, blue cloth, indigo cloth, gore, guts, slime, magenta, pink, orange flames, yellow flames, blue flames, steel armour, chrome, gold armour, sword, gun, staff, pentagram, cross, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Summoner, the high priest of an evil secret society, the tallest and thinnest figure: a narrow ornate ceremonial robe of deep blood red with gold embroidered sigils, a black mantle and a very tall pointed blood-red cowl; his gaunt face is pallid grey-white with dark veins round the eyes and one milky white eye; one hand raises a long ornate ritual dagger, its steel blade dripping bright red blood, and a black iron chain hangs from the other hand; simple shapes and very few details.

The figure is drawn large: about 40 pixels wide and 74 pixels tall. His face is a living old man's face with a nose, lips, eyebrows and sunken cheeks, pale grey skin and dark veins, clearly human and never a skull.
layers.negative: staff, sword, skull, skull face, skeleton, bones, tentacle, tentacles, glowing eyes, empty hood, blue robe, beard
